text:
ana_mkt: Greenroom checklist for next week's "Practical Inference" live demo. Need final signoffs: regional reg pages, timezone display, zoom audio tracks, and post-event nurture sequence. Quick confirm?

rohan_ops: I'll take Zoom + recordings. Settings: webinar (not meeting), cloud record MP4, separate audio tracks for presenters + interpreter, auto-transcript ON. Disable file transfer. Co-hosts: @ben_social + @rohan_ops.

ben_social: Landing copy done. Two headline variants for ads and organic. I added ?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=practical_inference_launch to all CTAs. Also adding a small GDPR checkbox and privacy link.

tess_sales: On the reg form please add "Current inference use-case" (dropdown). Map values to HubSpot property "inference_use_case" so SDRs can route.

rohan_ops: Field added. Zapier flow: reg -> enrich -> hubspot upsert -> assign owner based on region/use_case. Test sample passed. (zapier-bot: sample ok)

marshall_eng: Recording export checklist for post-prod:
```
- Wait for cloud processing notification
- Download master.mp4 + transcript.srt
- Run pii-scrub transcript --patterns pii_rules.txt
- Run clipper --src master.mp4 --intervals highlights.json --out clips/
- Upload to s3://redwood-assets/events/practical-inference/{date}/
```
I'll own the clipper job.

zoom-bot: Webinar scheduled. Meeting ID 1122334455. Cloud recording enabled. Transcript enabled. Reminder email scheduled (24h, 1h).

ana_mkt: (typo) I mean @ana_mkt: Who monitors chat and confirms the recording link within 90 minutes after end?

ben_social: I'll monitor chat and clip questions for social highlights. @tess_sales will stand by for hot leads.

tess_sales: On leads: live attendees with "demo" or "POC" in use_case -> AE ping within 6h. Replay viewers who click pricing -> SDR sequence at 48h. Mapping in sheets.

ana_mkt: Final messaging note: social copy should highlight one compelling benchmark line but avoid raw percent numbers without context. Use "noticeably lower latency at scale" and link to the replay.

rohan_ops: Preflight tasks done: timezone rendering checked, GDPR checkbox validated, retention set to 60 days, recording watermarking ON for EMEA set to 30d retention.

marshall_eng: After recording uploaded I'll post the internal link to #marketing and tag owners. Public replay ready at T+24h with captions after PII QA.

ana_mkt: Perfect. Owners: @ben_social (social + clips), @marshall_eng (clips + upload), @tess_sales (lead follow-up), @rohan_ops (zoom + infra). Thanks team  see you in the greenroom. :headphones:
